title: Hep大间隔配对 vs 同数量均匀配对
supporting_evidence: 两个负例来自不同rep/scheme，值得区分pair信息与稀疏化，而非继续正例seed。
counterevidence_and_competing_explanatio: 大gap也改变标签对分布/梯度，不等于真实噪声抑制证明；两seed仍有限。

parameters.q_fit_definition: median of all positive |z_i-z_j| for unordered i<j in this native fit only; even count median = mean of two central sorted gaps; no approximation; serialize q; no stress/stop Y used
parameters.batch_pair_universe: unordered i<j among the current training batch, exclude exact equal original Y (equivalently equal zY); no replacement; canonical pair identity uses original official-train row_index
parameters.gap_arm: select all current-batch pairs with |z_i-z_j|>=q_fit, let count be m_b; exact ties at q included
parameters.uniform_matched_arm: select exactly m_b distinct pairs from full unequal-label batch universe, smallest SHA256 keys; m_b computed from same batch true fit labels, never from predictions
parameters.hash_key_protocol: SHA256(UTF8("P004PAIR-v1|{task}|{split_id}|{model_seed}|{epoch_1based}|{batch_index_0based}|{min_row_index}|{max_row_index}")); order by digest bytes then row-index pair; dedicated deterministic mechanism does not advance torch/numpy/dataloader RNG
parameters.pair_loss: softplus(-sign(z_i-z_j)*(p_i-p_j)); mean over selected pairs; if m_b=0 return scalar0 with zero pair gradient
parameters.total_objective: 0.5*mean((p-zY)^2) over ALL rows in batch + 0.5*mean(selected pair losses)
parameters.q_interpretation: experimental pair-information selection, not an assay-noise estimate or empirically optimal threshold
parameters.preregistered_no_grid: one q quantile0.5 only; coefficient0.5 fixed; no q/lambda search; no extra seeds
parameters.logging: fit-only q/tie count; per-epoch aggregate pair cardinality and average label-gap summaries; loss components; no rowwise Valid or rowwise residual logs
parameters.equivalence_gate: if all eligible batches produce identical selections across arms, deterministic zero-fit fixture permits mathematical skip; do not force new runs; actual training trajectories not simulated here

valid_combinations_and_counting: 2表示×2方案×2mask×2共同seed=16gradient；H1取CheMscaffold和Minicanon=8，H2补其余8；共享16旧dense/Half控制只计一次。
search_strategy: 一个预设q，不做网格；H1先判选择信息vs稀疏效应，H2只有完成交互判别有价值才解锁。
stop_or_skip_rule: 无差异/均负关闭；同选择等价skip；不得改q或补seed以追正。
